no throttle: ArrowProjectile.SpawnArrow fires once per bow-draw cycle, each arrow is a distinct event, not a tight loop

qa_flags.description: AudioBank GameObject in the Unity scene must have door.wav assigned to sfxDoor slot in the Inspector. Without this, PlayDoor() is a graceful null no-op (no crash, silent door).
qa_flags.action: In Unity Editor: select AudioBank GO -> Inspector -> sfxDoor -> assign door.wav

qa_flags.description: AudioBank GameObject must have cook.wav assigned to sfxCook slot in the Inspector. Without this, PlayCook() is graceful null no-op.
qa_flags.action: In Unity Editor: select AudioBank GO -> Inspector -> sfxCook -> assign cook.wav

qa_flags.description: AudioBank GameObject must have shoot.wav assigned to sfxShoot slot in the Inspector. Without this, PlayShoot() is graceful null no-op.
qa_flags.action: In Unity Editor: select AudioBank GO -> Inspector -> sfxShoot -> assign shoot.wav

qa_flags.description: Unity will auto-generate .meta files on import. No manual .meta action needed; flag for QA to confirm import settings (AudioClip, LoadType=DecompressOnLoad, Mono, 44100Hz).

wiki_b9_acceptance.door: Opening a door (pawn passes through DoorEntity) -> door.wav plays (soft creak/thud, throttled 0.15s)
wiki_b9_acceptance.cook: Cooking at a stove (StoveEntity.CookOne succeeds) -> cook.wav plays (sizzle/clatter, throttled 0.5s)
wiki_b9_acceptance.shoot: Firing an arrow (ArrowProjectile.SpawnArrow called) -> shoot.wav plays (bow-twang, no throttle)

throttle_audit.door_calling_pattern: NotifyPassing() called by PawnMovement.Update() while pawn inside door trigger — could fire multiple frames; 0.15s bank throttle prevents buzz
throttle_audit.cook_calling_pattern: CookOne() called from PawnCook.Update() at outer cookInterval 1.5s — low risk, 0.5s bank guard covers multi-pawn edge case
throttle_audit.shoot_calling_pattern: SpawnArrow() called once per bow-draw cycle in PawnHunter — event-driven, not a frame loop; no throttle required
